resources.string: 1. Settings → System → About: press OK on «Android TV OS build» seven times.\n2. Settings → System → Developer options: turn on «USB debugging» (on some TVs «Network debugging»).\n3. Keep the phone on the same Wi-Fi as the TV.
No TV found. Check debugging is on, or type the address from Settings → Network on the TV.
The phone is not on Wi-Fi.
On the TV: tick «Always allow from this computer» and press Allow.
Done. Likhtar is open on the TV and will offer to become the home screen; the TV asks to allow debugging once more, for Likhtar itself.
The TV is not answering on port 5555. Is debugging on and is the address right?
Debugging was not allowed on the TV. Press Install again and allow it.
This TV only allows wireless debugging with pairing, which this app does not support yet. Install with Downloader or a USB stick instead.
The connection to the TV dropped. Try again.
Could not download Likhtar. Check the phone\'s internet.
